data.text:
INC WITHDRAWS REQUEST TO USE PEOPLE POWER MONUMENT FOR PEACE RALLY

Apparently, sabi ni tweety bird, inatras na kani-kanina lang yung letter dated October 28 requesting for the use of EDSA People Power Monument.

Note though that Nov. 3 yung date sa letter but the receiving stamp says Nov. 4 – 5:11pm.

Awww bakit naman nila inatras?

Narinig ba nila ang ingay sa social media or lilipat lang sila ng venue?

Pwede naman sila sa Quirino Grandstand like last January 13, 2025 na Peace Rally.

Or pwede ulet sa Liwasang Bonifacio kung san madalas langawin ang mga DDS.

Either way, naka bantay kami sa kahit anong rally na gustong patalsikin ang gobyerno para lang maiupo ang mas masahol na pulitiko.

Abangan ang susunod na kabanata!

#TrillionPesoMarch

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 10 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line and Typhoon TINO
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 04 November 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Real, Mauban, Polillo, Burdeos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Jomalig).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Nueva Ecija, Tarlac, Zambales, Laguna, Cavite, Batangas and Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, Tayabas, Lucban, Lucena, Pagbilao, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, Unisan) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal, Bataan, Metro Manila, Bulacan(Bocaue, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Santa Maria, Marilao, Obando, Bulakan, Balagtas, Pandi, Norzagaray, Hagonoy, Paombong, Malolos, Guiguinto) and Pampanga(Masantol, Macabebe, Sasmuan, Lubao) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
